cc:Work.dc:title: Penis Cross Section
cc:Work.dc:description:
Cross section of the penis with emphasis on fascial layers, labeled from most superficial to deepest.
Corrected Feb 20, 2014 to show Buck's fascia splitting to envelop the spongiosum separately from the corpora.
